products.name: Hampton Inn & Suites Chino Hills
products.description: Located in Chino Hills, Hampton Inn & Suites Chino Hills is within a 5-minute drive of The Shoppes at Chino Hills and Ayala Park. Featured amenities include complimentary wired Internet access, a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in Chino Hills? This hotel features 720 square feet (65 square meters) of event facilities. Free self parking is available onsite.
